scope: Broaden the optional downstream 2D DXF consumer screen and reconcile current peer failure reports with existing local source/tests, without duplicating findings or promoting support.

evidenceKinds: read-only local source and generated-test inventory
notPerformed: QCAD, LibreDWG, FreeCAD, or ACadSharp runtime execution

observations: QCAD Community Edition is a GPLv3 2D application with DXF support; QCAD Professional adds proprietary DWG and enhanced DXF plugins.
The current QCAD feature matrix lists DXF R15/AC1015 for Community Edition; the broader R11-R32 DWG/DXF version matrix is Professional-only.
QCAD CE cannot write 24-bit colors to DXF; exclude group-420/truecolor round-trip claims from this route.
The QCAD DXF module documents dxflib as its underlying implementation.
The current developer module index still describes QCAD's DXF module as based on dxflib; the documented DL_WriterA is an ASCII writer.
Official QCAD documentation describes headless, script-driven operation using -no-gui, -autostart, and the offscreen Qt platform option.
limits: Documentation does not demonstrate QCAD behavior on current libdxfrw output.
QCAD and dxflib are one parser lineage, not independent parser votes.
The feature matrix does not establish AC1021+ / modern DXF, Binary DXF, DWG, or 3D support in Community Edition.
The command-line scripting documentation does not establish binary-DXF capability for every Community Edition build.
No DWG, ACIS, ACDSDATA, or B-rep claim follows from the Community Edition route.
evidence.planAction: Add only an optional one-time AC1015 ASCII common-2D QCAD CE consumer check at the existing composed checkpoint, conditional on an already available exact CE build. Pin build, script, command line, settings, warnings, document inventories, and output hash; use a hand-authored expectation manifest. Exclude 24-bit/group-420 round-trip claims.

observations: GDAL's current DXF driver documentation describes Binary DXF input and AC1027+ extensible mode that returns raw ASM plus a transform rather than decoded modeler geometry.
LibreDWG's manual and fuzz harness document separate conversion/check/fuzz regression workflows; they are process precedents, not independent semantic truth.
ezdxf distinguishes ordinary strict loading from recovery for flawed DXF inputs.
BRL-CAD issue #228 remains open and proposed fix PR #245 remains unmerged in the reviewed public pages.
limits: These current peer contracts do not establish a new local libdxfrw defect or support result.
A recovered file is not a clean strict-read result; raw ASM plus transform is not B-rep semantics.
BRL-CAD is not admitted as a malformed-polyface comparator until its fix is merged and pinned.
evidence.planAction: Retain existing strict/recovery, raw-carrier/geometry, parser/writer, and optional-fuzz evidence separations. Add no new finding or mandatory test lane.

observations: FreeCAD documents a native C++ DXF importer/exporter and a separate legacy Python DXF route.
FreeCAD delegates DWG conversion to an external converter and then imports the produced DXF.
limits: Mutable main-branch sources and documentation are not a pinned runtime qualification.
A QCAD consumer run is not equivalent to FreeCAD's selected converter/importer chain.
evidence.planAction: Keep QCAD CE as a separate optional application-consumer cell; retain exact converter/importer identity and intermediate-DXF accounting in the existing FreeCAD gate.

observations: #1409 reports a peer block-writer iteration defect that can skip later block bodies.
#1410 reports DXF-to-DWG failures involving zero-valued HATCH coordinates, unusual attribute tags, and embedded MTEXT fields.
#1411 reports version-scoped R2013+ AcDs/SAB loss while typed REGION records survive.
#1413 reports peer NOD discovery based on object ordering/lowest handles, causing layout dictionaries to be missed.

localCrossCheck.localEvidence: tests/block_owner_tests.cpp:testConsecutiveNamedBlockOwnership covers consecutive owner inventories in ASCII and binary DXF.

tests/dxf_fixture_tests.cpp:testZeroYHatch and embedded-MTEXT framing controls cover explicit zero coordinates and embedded fields; unusual attribute-tag policy remains bounded by format/consumer evidence.
The existing S8 AcDs/SAB route separates section, record, payload, owner association, and semantic checks.
src/libdxfrw.cpp:dxfRW::writeObjects emits the regenerated root dictionary first; tests/dxf_fixture_tests.cpp and tests/dwg2dxf_adapter_tests.cpp exercise the root-first OBJECTS boundary.

limits: Peer issue reports are not independent reproductions on this checkout.
The existing local cross-check does not establish every related field behavior, external-reader acceptance, or general support.
evidence.planAction: Reuse existing test owners and AcDs gates; add no duplicate finding or CTest. Do not generalize unusual-tag acceptance from an issue report or infer peer results are current-master behavior.

observations: The current release listing identifies v3.8.0 at signed commit 3a1c66b; the listed release entry concerns assembly visibility.
The earlier v3.6.51 release notes report specific DXF OBJECTS writer and ACIS/AcDs reader work.
limits: Release notes do not establish family-level completeness or actual runtime outcomes.
Earlier feature notes do not substitute for a run of a pinned current package/build.
evidence.planAction: Bind optional ACadSharp comparisons to an exact artifact/source commit and actual route; record full versus partial read, notifications, per-handle disposition, output version, and audit.
